title: Solo Developer Window 2026: Ship and Operate Before AGI
description: Solo developers have a window: skills cut build costs now, but platforms absorb features fast. Who survived absorption, and what to own before AGI arrives.

attribution.citation: Json House, "Solo Developer Window 2026: Ship and Operate Before AGI", jsonhouse.com (2026-10-30)

key_facts.fact: Stanford's payroll study finds no evidence of widespread, economy-wide job displacement from generative AI, using ADP data through June 2026
Employment of workers aged 22–25 in AI-exposed occupations stands 19% below where it would be had it kept pace with less-exposed peers; experienced workers show no comparable gap
US software development postings rose almost 15% after late February 2025 while overall postings fell 7%, and remain about 27.5% below their pre-pandemic level
71% of the increase in US software development postings between May 2025 and May 2026 came from senior roles
ChatGPT record mode reached Team users on 2025-06-04; Granola then raised $125M at a $1.5B valuation on 2026-03-25 and Otter closed $320M in growth financing on 2026-10-20
key_facts.source: OpenAI release notes; Granola; Otter via Business Wire

key_facts.fact: TechCrunch links the closures of Relay and Huxe to larger platforms building similar features, but neither company gave that reason in the reports read for this dataset
Snyk's scan of 3,984 agent skills from ClawHub and skills.sh found 13.4% with a critical issue, 36.82% with any issue, and 76 confirmed malicious payloads
The ARC-AGI-3 launch results had frontier models averaging 0.51% on novel environments against 100% for human testers

faq_summary.a: Not across the board so far. Stanford finds no widespread displacement, but young workers in AI-exposed occupations sit 19% below their expected path while experienced workers show no comparable gap.

faq_summary.q: Can a feature launch from OpenAI kill a startup?
faq_summary.a: It can remove the reason to buy a product, but the record is mixed. TechCrunch links Relay and Huxe to platform overlap without either company giving that reason, and Granola and Otter raised money after ChatGPT added meeting recording.

faq_summary.q: Do agent skills plus unlimited tokens equal AGI?
faq_summary.a: No. Skills package human procedures, ARC-AGI-3 launch results put frontier models at 0.51% against 100% for humans, and metered cost remains a real constraint.

faq_summary.q: What should a solo developer build before AGI?
faq_summary.a: A running service, not only a shipped feature. Revenue, customer relationships, and data collected over time can outlast a feature that a platform copies.
